validation: Strict object and numeric types, no bool/string/NaN/Infinity, unknown fields rejected. Entire prior binds request id. Existing generation/session are top-level and exact server pin includes both maps/family/calibration/source and prior exact-stamp pose.

response.quality_ambiguity_unresolved: Preserve original boolean: true for ambiguous global result, false for nonambiguous. Every prior-bearing result still requires conditional proof and range checks.
proof_required_semantics: prior accepted monotonic time and expiry
retained and eligible and matching candidate counts
candidate versus user draft xy/yaw distances
original_ambiguity_unresolved equals original result and quality boolean

selection: All original retained candidates validated under unchanged existing non-ambiguity quality policy. Zero or multiple admissible candidates inside prior bounds reject. No ranking choice, override elevation, ambiguity flag rewrite or deduplication changes. Missing/malformed/known truncated candidate sets reject. One candidate is only conditional on operator input within the retained hypotheses, never globally unique or measured accuracy.
confirmation: Fresh server-owned proof must be independently revalidated by coordinator at confirm. Explicit conditional_prior_acknowledged confirms conditional result; original ambiguity boolean remains unchanged. Keep geometry source proposal_confirmed to retain every gate, but use distinct robot-scope.proposal-handoff.operator-prior-v1 with mandatory prior proof. Every prior-bearing result including original unique result is range/TTL/proof checked. No-prior v1 path unchanged. The latest propagated navigation-base pose must satisfy both the operator bounds and the existing candidate handoff distance at explicit geometry confirmation.
handoff: Expiry cannot exceed either existing handoff TTL or prior expiry. Existing exact session/stop/worker/source/map/calibration/one-use fences preserved. Later INITIAL POSE must satisfy existing candidate reference 0.25m/0.20rad AND bound operator prior region; do not widen either. Never overwrite user marker with candidate.
frontend: Stage 1 includes map pair and non-sendable local initial pose draft, uncertainty bounds and explicit current-stationary acknowledgment. Use existing lower INITIAL POSE drawing tool via text guidance, no duplicate draw/send/start buttons. Proposal action reads exact fresh draft binding; changes invalidate proposal selection. Show degrees to user and convert to radians in API. UI numeric bounds initially empty (no implicit confidence). Existing no-prior API preserved; advanced/manual geometry behavior preserved. Stage 4 groups actual INITIAL POSE acceptance check followed by existing explicit alignment start. Remaining estimate/goal steps displayed as 5/6; internal gate sequence unchanged. No automatic Nav2, pose, alignment, goal or retry.
draft_retention: Transient query failure preserves coordinates as previous unconfirmed draft with actions disabled. Confirmed different map/revision/generation invalidates. No reactivation on page refresh or sensor/runtime restart. Explicit reconfirmation under exact matching current map context required; actual pose sending remains after Nav2.
hardware: Offline checkpoint only; no deployment or fresh sensor application in this checkpoint. Historical observations do not establish current device state or a new field window.
